title: ループの中の集計を annotate と Subquery に寄せる
summary: 顧客ごとの count() と sum() を Count と Sum の annotate にし、JOIN を 2 つ重ねて件数を掛け算にしてしまい、distinct=True と Subquery で直してから最新の注文を OuterRef で付ける。

files.content:
from django.db import models


class Customer(models.Model):
    name = models.CharField(max_length=100)


class Order(models.Model):
    customer = models.ForeignKey(Customer, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="orders")
    total = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=0)
    status = models.CharField(max_length=20)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField()


class Ticket(models.Model):
    customer = models.ForeignKey(Customer, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="tickets")
    subject = models.CharField(max_length=200)

assistant.body:
from django.db.models import Count, OuterRef, Subquery, Sum
from django.http import JsonResponse

from .models import Customer, Order


def customer_report(request):
    order_totals = (
        Order.objects.filter(customer=OuterRef("pk"))
        .values("customer")
        .annotate(total=Sum("total"))
        .values("total")
    )
    customers = Customer.objects.annotate(
        order_count=Count("orders", distinct=True),
        ticket_count=Count("tickets", distinct=True),
        total_spent=Subquery(order_totals),
    ).order_by("name")
    rows = [
        {
            "name": c.name,
            "order_count": c.order_count,
            "ticket_count": c.ticket_count,
            "total_spent": c.total_spent or 0,
        }
        for c in customers
    ]
    return JsonResponse({"customers": rows})

from django.db.models import Count, OuterRef, Subquery, Sum
from django.http import JsonResponse

from .models import Customer, Order


def customer_report(request):
    order_totals = (
        Order.objects.filter(customer=OuterRef("pk"))
        .values("customer")
        .annotate(total=Sum("total"))
        .values("total")
    )
    latest = Order.objects.filter(customer=OuterRef("pk")).order_by("-created_at", "-pk")
    customers = Customer.objects.annotate(
        order_count=Count("orders", distinct=True),
        ticket_count=Count("tickets", distinct=True),
        total_spent=Subquery(order_totals),
        last_ordered_at=Subquery(latest.values("created_at")[:1]),
        last_status=Subquery(latest.values("status")[:1]),
    ).order_by("name")
    rows = [
        {
            "name": c.name,
            "order_count": c.order_count,
            "ticket_count": c.ticket_count,
            "total_spent": c.total_spent or 0,
            "last_ordered_at": c.last_ordered_at,
            "last_status": c.last_status,
        }
        for c in customers
    ]
    return JsonResponse({"customers": rows})
